The main takeaway from our work is that
the lunar Cherenko technique has a strong directional dependence, and that the potential exposure to UHE neutrinos is much greater in certain directions than others.
the lunar Cherenko technique has the potential to provide the best sensitivity to a UHE point source flux of all existing and future experiments.
